shared_elements: carved or incised linear motifs on an irregular stone slab
justification: A shows relief-carved human figures in profile (a head with facial features, an arm/hand, a fan or feathered object, and a rectangular sign), whereas B shows a purely linear, schematic composition of nested arches enclosing a triangular/vertical framework above a row of scalloped arcs, with no figures at all. The only correspondence is the very generic presence of curved enclosing lines and incised motifs on an irregular slab, which any tradition could produce independently.
